result.instructions: Tools for Jurnal, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the profit and loss for this month."; "Which sales invoices are still unpaid, largest balance first?"; "List my vendors and what I owe each of them.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Jurnal data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jurnal_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jurnal_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jurnal_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. jurnal_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jurnal_get_current_user

tools.description: The Jurnal user the credential acts as: id, name, email, status, owner flag and roles. GET /public/jurnal/api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: jurnal_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: The Jurnal company (or companies) the credential belongs to: id, name, industry, address, tax number, currency settings and feature flags. GET /companies.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

page_size.description: Results per page, 1-100 (Jurnal's default applies when omitted).

sort_key.description: Sort field: display_name, billing_address, email, phone, balance_customer.

include_archive.description: false = only active (non-archived) records; Jurnal includes archived ones by default.
